tools.name: boxtal_list_content_categories
tools.description: List the Boxtal content categories (what a parcel contains) that a shipping order accepts. Boxtal API: GET /v3.1/content-category.

tools.name: boxtal_find_parcel_points
tools.description: Find parcel pickup and drop-off points (relay points, lockers) near an address, optionally for chosen networks. Boxtal API: GET /v3.1/parcel-point.

tools.name: boxtal_get_shipping_order
tools.description: Get one Boxtal shipping order: its status (PENDING, REQUESTED, CONFIRMED or CANCELLED), dates and prices. Boxtal API: GET /v3.1/shipping-order/{id}.

tools.name: boxtal_get_tracking
tools.description: Get the tracking history of the packages in a shipping order (status, events, tracking number). Boxtal API: GET /v3.1/shipping-order/{id}/tracking.

tools.name: boxtal_get_shipping_documents
tools.description: Get the shipping documents of an order (label, proforma, CN23, voucher) with their download URLs. Boxtal API: GET /v3.1/shipping-order/{id}/shipping-document.

tools.name: boxtal_create_shipping_order
tools.description: WRITE: creates AND ORDERS a real shipment on the customer's Boxtal account, which is billed to that account. Use it only when the user asks to ship that parcel. tools.name: boxtal_cancel_shipping_order
tools.description: WRITE: cancels a shipping order on the customer's Boxtal account. The cancel can fail once the carrier has taken the parcel. Boxtal API: DELETE /v3.1/shipping-order/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: boxtal_get_shipping_documents, boxtal_create_shipping_order · Private data: boxtal_get_shipping_documents · Public sink: boxtal_create_shipping_order · Destructive: boxtal_find_parcel_points, boxtal_cancel_shipping_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: boxtal_get_shipping_documents, boxtal_create_shipping_order · Private data: boxtal_get_shipping_documents · Public sink: boxtal_create_shipping_order · Destructive: boxtal_find_parcel_points, boxtal_cancel_shipping_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
